questions.question: You're planning a party and your friend suggests having it at their place. You want to agree, but you also have some concerns about noise levels.
options: I completely disagree, I don't think that's a good idea.
Let's discuss this further, I'm not sure yet.
That sounds perfect, let's go with your suggestion!
Sorry, I don't think we can afford the extra costs.
questions.answer: That sounds perfect, let's go with your suggestion!

questions.question: You're at a job interview and the interviewer asks you about your previous work experience. You want to express your opinion on why you think you'd be suitable for the role.
options: I don't have any relevant experience, but I'm eager to learn.
To be honest, I've had some bad experiences in my previous jobs.
I think my skills and qualifications make me an ideal candidate for this position.
I'm not sure what you're looking for in a candidate.
questions.answer: I think my skills and qualifications make me an ideal candidate for this position.

questions.question: You're chatting with a friend at the park and they ask if you'd like to join them for a coffee. You're not sure, but you don't want to be rude.
options: Sorry, I'm on a tight budget this month.
I'd love to, but I have an exam coming up.
That sounds lovely, let's go!
No thanks, I'm trying to cut down on caffeine.

questions.question: You're at a formal dinner party and the host asks for your opinion on a recent news story. You want to express your opinion politely.
options: To be honest, I think it's all a bit of a waste of time.
I'm not really sure what to say about that.
I think it's an interesting topic, but we should focus on the positives.
I completely disagree with the way they handled it.
questions.answer: I think it's an interesting topic, but we should focus on the positives.

questions.question: You're talking to a customer service representative and they offer to help you with your query. You want to thank them for their assistance.
options: Thanks so much, I really appreciate it!
Sorry, I think there's been a misunderstanding.
I'm not sure if that's the right solution...
That's okay, I can figure it out myself.
questions.answer: Thanks so much, I really appreciate it!
